contract_compliance.dereplication_representation: 99% ANI dereplicated representatives (113 Archaeal MAGs out of 2,321 total MAGs), not necessarily 95% ANI species representatives
contract_compliance.psm_and_peptide_fdr_method: Metadata-verified upstream MS-GF:QValue (search_engine_score[6] <= 0.01) and MS-GF:PepQValue (search_engine_score[3] <= 0.01) across all 30 .mzTab files; discordant_psm_q_rows=0; no reconstructed peptide FDR.
contract_compliance.search_background_and_il_specificity: Audited 604 deposited files in MassIVE MSV000097826: found 0/15 split composite search FASTAs -> full_background_verified=False. Streamed multipattern I/L specificity across 122370 valid EMSL50964 proteins, 274006 Stage 1 v2 Archaeal MAG ORFs, 55460 contaminant/Arabidopsis proteins, and all .mzTab co-occurring accessions. Primary global single-MAG uniqueness is marked non-estimable when full_background_verified is False.
contract_compliance.spectrum_quantification_rule: Protein, family, and clade spectral counts are computed via aggregate_unique_spectra_for_entity (set union of unique spectra_ref per sample), never summing across duplicate aliases or paralogs, and restricting family/clade warming calculations strictly to family/clade-unambiguous peptides.
contract_compliance.primary_family_and_clade_warming_estimab: Because the full 15-split 5%-FDR composite search FASTAs are unavailable in public repositories (full_background_verified=False), primary family-specific and clade-level warming responses are nonestimable_full_search_background_unavailable. All family and clade paired differences are reported strictly as observed_subset_provisional_sensitivity diagnostics; no positive warming claim is made. Protein-to-DNA ratios are descriptive sensitivities, not causal activity estimates.
contract_compliance.log2_fold_change_zero_policy: Arbitrary 1e-6 pseudocounts at zeros are removed (eliminating artifactual log2FC ~24-30 values). Paired differences (heated - control) are the primary metric. Descriptive log2(heated/control) is only defined when both values > 0; pairs involving zero are reported with explicit detection states.
contract_compliance.experimental_design: 30 samples = 3 paired plots x 2 treatments (control, heated) x 5 nested depths, all sampled June 2018; paired DNA recruitment restricted strictly to 2018 metagenomes.
contract_compliance.statistical_inference_note: With n=3 paired plots, exact whole-plot sign-flip permutation has 8 configurations and minimum achievable two-sided p = 0.25.
contract_compliance.claim_boundary: Strongest permitted claim is external homolog/clade protein deployment in Blodgett Forest conifer soil (Karaoz 2026); does NOT prove expression in Empty Quarter desert soils or establish biochemical mechanism.
